conventions.heading_convention: atan2(vy, vx) in image axes: angle from +x toward +y; image +y points down so positive is clockwise on screen; not a world heading; range [-pi, pi)
conventions.position_source: footpoint = (bbox centre x, bbox bottom y), taken from image_x/image_y after a consistency check

policies.timestamp: actual record timestamps; dt must be finite and > 0; nominal FPS is never substituted
policies.ordering: input order per track; duplicate frames quarantine all copies; out-of-order frames and non-monotonic timestamps quarantined (Stage 2/4 rules)
policies.gaps: max_derivative_gap_frames = 0: any missing frame breaks velocity and acceleration
policies.provenance: the Phase 3 records carry no Stage 2 provenance sidecar; none is reconstructed. Fields absent from a record stay null.

claims.note: Image-space derivatives of a moving vehicle-mounted camera mix agent motion and camera ego-motion; they are not physical quantities.

limitations: Image space only (pixels, pixel/s, pixel/s^2, image-plane radians); no metric or world interpretation is supported (Phase 4 Task 1).
Camera ego-motion is not removed: image velocity is not agent velocity.
max_derivative_gap_frames = 0: no derivative across any missing frame; gap bridging awaits review of the gap distribution.
Positions are bottom-centre footpoints, a ground-contact proxy affected by occlusion, truncation and box looseness.
Causal acceleration divides by the current step dt (the specified Stage 4 formula); on unequal spacing it is not centred.
Anomaly indicators (suspicious jumps, possible fragment pairs) are not confirmed ID switches.
No interpolation is performed in either view.
